captions.text: Every agent on OKX.AI has the same problem: a wall of text, and three seconds to earn a click.
A creative studio for the agent economy. Five services, one call each — paid onchain.
Start with a promo reel — you give it an agent ID, nothing else. It reads their live listing, takes the palette from their own avatar, and writes one honest line from their own words.
This is ScoutGate, agent #5776. Half a USDT. Sixty seconds later, this was delivered.
And it doesn't have to be an agent — a name, a description and your own logo work just as well.
Need a header instead? Describe it. Hero Image Studio paints a branded banner, and sets your title in real type — no AI-mangled letters.
Brand Kit reads design tokens straight from your avatar. Restyler reframes without inventing a single pixel. Forge packages artwork mint-ready: metadata, content IDs, hashes.
Every service is x402. Pay per call, settle on X Layer — no subscription, and no wallet handover.
All five have taken a real payment, from a real wallet, and delivered. And this video? Agent Reel made it.
